meta.notes: Hodgdon-family product pages are on shop.hodgdon.com, which is blocked from this sandbox. Hodgdon/IMR/Winchester records come from: (1) the 2026 relative burn-rate chart (names, order; status=current); (2) the latest Hodgdon Annual Manual PDF published free on hodgdonpowderco.com/reloading-manuals-library (AM25 = 2025 Annual Manual): its earlier-edition burn-rate chart, its "Powder Usage" matrix (applications = the SHOTGUN/PISTOL/RIFLE sections a powder is listed in -> shotshell/handgun/rifle; usage = the column headings ticked for PISTOL/RIFLE), and its per-powder descriptions (form from the words spherical/Ball powder/flake/extruded, base from "double-base"/"single-base", temperature claims); (3) brand-page featured-product one-liners, the Winchester "Staball family" and IMR "Enduron" statements; (4) the OCR'd COVER PAGE of each scanned Hodgdon SDS (title such as "Spherical Powders"/"Extruded Rifle Powders"/"Double Base Powders"/"Single Base Powders"/"BALL Powder Propellant", the product names listed, [DISCONTINUED] marks); evidence from OCR is prefixed "[OCR]"; numeric composition in the scanned SDS was NOT extracted (OCR digits unreliable; tables keyed by internal codes); (5) the 2012 Hodgdon Extreme-series web printout. When sources disagree the first value is kept (order: Annual Manual > brand pages > SDS covers > 2012 printout for the Hodgdon family; product page > SDS for Alliant) and all values are listed in conflicts. Alliant records come from www.alliantpowder.com product pages, Alliant SDS PDFs (Section 3 nitroglycerin bands, Section 9 appearance; byte-identical duplicates de-duplicated) and the 2023 Reloader's Guide (burn order and uses). nitroglycerinPct is set only where a single figure is stated (Alliant guide: Bullseye 40 %, American Select 2 %). nitroglycerinPctRange holds SDS family bands (not product-specific). baseBasis="sds-composition" means base was inferred from an Alliant SDS listing nitroglycerin with lowest band >= 4 % together with Alliant's own definition of double-base; "stated" means a page says it; Hodgdon-family base values are stated by an SDS cover title or the Annual Manual text. temperatureStableClaim is maker text (sentences containing temperature wording; end-of-line hyphenation removed), not a boolean, and claims differ in strength. Alliant applications are keyword categories from the product page category/principal/secondary use and guide uses (raw text in principalUse/secondaryUse/guideUse). bulkDensityGcc, heatOfExplosionJg and grainDimensions are null everywhere: none of these documents publish them. burnRateRanks are chart positions (ordinal), not quantitative burn rates; the Hodgdon and Alliant charts order some powders differently. usage holds, per application, the Annual Manual matrix column headings ticked (PISTOL: TARGET/LIGHT DUTY/MEDIUM DUTY/MAGNUM; RIFLE: TARGET/SILHOUETTE/LIGHT/MEDIUM/MAGNUM/50 CAL); usage.shotshell is null because the SHOTGUN sub-columns (gauge/load class) were not parsed. temperatureClaims lists every claim with its source. Page numbers are PDF page indices (1-based), not printed folios. fieldEvidence maps each populated field to the verbatim, whitespace-collapsed lines it came from; "evidence" joins them with " || ".
